title: Not good to be alone (Genesis 2:18–25)
hookLine: the first not good in the Bible is loneliness
carry: bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh

lines: THEN, FOR THE FIRST TIME: NOT GOOD.
cards: Count the goods so far. Light, good. Land and sea, good.
Plants, lights, sea creatures and birds, animals: good, good, good, good. Then everything at once, very good. Seven times, in the first chapter.
And then, in the garden, for the first time, the story says the opposite. Not good. There's no sin yet.
No serpent, no fruit, nobody has done anything wrong. And still, something is not good. It isn't a flaw in the garden, or in the animals, or in the man.

teach.h: HELP MEET: A HELP THAT FITS.
teach.b: Here it is in the King James Bible: "And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him." Help meet has caused a lot of confusion.
Meet just means fitting, as in the old phrase it is meet and right. So a help meet is a help that fits.
Later, English ran the two words together into helpmeet, and even helpmate, and some readers heard a junior assistant. The Hebrew doesn't say that.

teach.h: EZER: THE WORD USED FOR GOD.
teach.b: The word for help is ezer, and elsewhere the Bible uses it for God.
When a psalm says my help cometh from the LORD, the Hebrew word for help is from this same family. Some readers put it this way: ezer is help from strength, not from below.
The second word means something like corresponding to him, facing him, a partner. Then the animals pass by, as you heard yesterday, and none of them is the one.
So God puts the man into a deep sleep and builds a woman from his side. The Hebrew word often translated rib can also mean side, as in the side of a building.

teach.h: THE MAN WAKES WITH A POEM.
teach.b: The man wakes up, and what comes out is a little poem: "This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh." Some churches read this passage at weddings. But it reaches further than marriage.

teach.h: IT IS NOT GOOD THAT THE MAN SHOULD BE ALONE.
teach.b: In the story, the first thing God calls not good is a person with no one beside them. Friends, family, neighbors: readers hear in it that people were made for each other.

how: Genesis 2 is among the readings some churches use at weddings, and some churches run visiting ministries for people who live alone, the housebound and the bereaved.

o: a servant who works under a master
a wife, the Hebrew word for a spouse
help, a word the Bible also uses for God

games.q: what's inside the story — tap the pairs.
p: help, a word also used for God
the word can also mean side

s: the first not good in the Bible comes after the first sin
it comes before any sin: a man, alone, in a brand-new garden.
help meet means a junior assistant
meet means fitting. ezer, help, is a word the Bible also uses for God.
when the man wakes and sees the woman, he speaks a little poem
"this is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh."

games.q: God has brought every animal to the man, and he has named them all. what's still missing?
o: a partner who fits him, someone beside him.
games.why: none of the animals is the one. "it is not good that the man should be alone."

practice: Let a face come to mind: someone who lives alone, or lost a partner, or just moved to a new city, or stays quiet in the group chat.
Picture where they are right now and what their evening might look like, and keep them company in your mind without trying to fix anything. If you pray, you can pray for them by name.

wordCard.voice: Ezer. The Hebrew word for help, used elsewhere for God's own help: the fitting partner God made for the man.

orig.note: Hebrew: help. Elsewhere in the Bible the word is used for God's help.

carryVoice: Your line: bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. The first not good was a person alone. That's day three hundred thirty-seven.
